data.policy: Group policy applies to all controlled entities, branches and joint ventures. Screen customers, beneficial owners, directors, employees, suppliers, end-users, intermediaries and transactions at onboarding, daily and before payment/shipment against the scenario versions of Poland, EU, UN, UK and OFAC lists. Compliance investigates alerts; transactions are held pending clearance. Quarterly risk review, annual independent audit (last 2026-06-30), annual staff training, escalation and incident records are maintained.
data.isolation: Issuer accounts, lending, guarantees, payment routes and platforms are excluded from covered activities; segregated ledgers and separate banking channels are used, treasury blocks covered payments and cash-pool transfers, compliance approves routing and reconciles monthly. No indirect issuer financing or settlement is permitted.

licenses.activity: Administrative closure and recovery of existing receivables only; no new sales/investment

data.negative_declaration: Complete reviewed scope includes indirect customers/suppliers, agents, ownership, investments, branches, joint ventures and all controlled subsidiaries, including non-bank customers. No other current, FY2025 or contemplated country activities beyond the activity register; no other sanctions-party, government, oil, new Russia/Belarus investment, Ukraine specified-region, dual-use or CHPL involvement beyond explicit entries.
